Name: SynthKitten's Level Progress Viewer
Author: SynthKittenDev
Description:
Want to stop guessing your progress? SynthKitten’s Level Progress Viewer displays your current XP and how much more you need to level up! Just hover over a skill and you’re all set.

Simply open your inventory, go to 'Skills' and hover over which skill you want to inspect!
